forum.title: Two OSPI usage in STM32U599
forum.content_text:
Hello,

Is it possible to use two OSPI with below configuration.  I can make this configuration in cubeMx but whiel debugging ospi1 is not working after ospi2 initialize.

![Epamuk_1-1777024547409.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e4e74f0c-41e3-fbfa-3a5f-948784c0350c.png "Epamuk_1-1777024547409.png")![Epamuk_2-1777024564617.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/acf133a4-2cf5-45dc-8cc3-b859a6692e84.png "Epamuk_2-1777024564617.png")![Epamuk_3-1777024580076.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b55ad3ec-f9cf-0fa7-6ca6-064364dce3cf.png "Epamuk_3-1777024580076.png")

![Epamuk_4-1777024592601.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/eaa4b096-cef6-e836-7cfb-1afba546de00.png "Epamuk_4-1777024592601.png")

![Epamuk_5-1777024603515.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1cbb40c8-7a08-3f00-987b-7ccd74512e2b.png "Epamuk_5-1777024603515.png")

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @Epamuk ;

 

First of all thank you for sharing this behavior in the community.

Could you please look at this issue Solved: OCTOSPI: HAL_OSPIM_Config() - STMicroelectronics Community. I think you are experiencing the same issue.

 

To solve the issue could you please try to modify these code lines in octospi.c file

 

 

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_LOW;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi1, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }
 

 

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi2, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 

by

 

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_LOW;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOHighPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH;
 sOspiManagerCfg.DQSPort = 1;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi1, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 

 

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_LOW;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOHighPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH;
 sOspiManagerCfg.DQSPort = 2;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi2, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 

Please let me know if the issue is solved or not?

Thank you.

Kaouthar
scraped_replies.author: KDJEM.1

scraped_replies.html:
Hello, my code was like (cubeMX created that)

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_LOW;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi1, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 2;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi2, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

I added only  sOspiManagerCfg.IOHighPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH; to OSPI1 init like below

 sOspiManagerCfg.ClkPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.NCSPort = 1;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOLowPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_LOW;
 sOspiManagerCfg.IOHighPort = HAL_OSPIM_IOPORT_1_HIGH;
 if (HAL_OSPIM_Config(&hospi1, &sOspiManagerCfg, HAL_OSPI_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT_VALUE) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 and it works fine .  

Thanks
